STORED_IN keys=135 edges=135 dist={1: 135} by_type={S3_BUCKET_POLICY: 135} and SERVED_FROM keys=27 edges=27 dist={1: 27} by_type={S3_BUCKET_POLICY: 27} -- both 100 percent onto the shadow class. The reach also passes the producers: debtscan_canon_scorer.py:48 and :144 name ServedURL-[SERVED_FROM]->S3_BUCKET_POLICY as AUTH_CANON's live shape -- the wrong-class landing is already adopted as canon in a scored artifact -- while canon_motif_scorer.py:131 names the dominant motif (ServedURL)-[SERVED_FROM]->(S3). Two scorers, one edge, two accounts of what it points at. And the graph already answers STORED_IN's question correctly elsewhere: OWNED_BY carries S3Key -> S3_BUCKET on 232 keys, {1: 232}, on the ARN-keyed node; all 135 STORED_IN source keys also carry an OWNED_BY edge (135 of 135) naming the same bucket (135 of 135).
(3) HEALTHY ONLY BY ACCIDENT. ROUTES_TO (86 keys, 86 edges, {1: 86}, onto LAMBDA) is resolved through lam_by_name, the same name-index shape that produced the bucket defect; it is correct today only because a LAMBDA's node_id IS its arn, so 'arn or nid' cannot pick the wrong string. Give a LAMBDA node a second key -- an alias, a versioned arn, a name-keyed shadow -- and ROUTES_TO acquires the identical failure while its resolution rate stays 100 percent. Separately, ORIGIN (keys=1, edges=5), USES_OAI (keys=1, edges=4) and USES_OAC (keys=1, edges=1) have single-node source populations and already read above one edge per key: structurally legitimate, but a rate reported on them would be the same wrong quantity.

A rate measures DANGLING, not CORRECTNESS -- STORED_IN resolved 98.5 percent and 100 percent of what resolved is on the wrong class, invisible to the producer's own dangling check because a shadow node is a real node. A rate over EDGES hides fan-out -- 764 of 764 was 191 facts fanned four ways. DERIVES_FROM's 216 of 216 is an edge rate too: 216 edges over 121 keys, {1: 84, 2: 20, 3: 13, 4: 1, 12: 1, 16: 1, 21: 1}, 1.79 per key. And a both-identity POPULATION is not a defect population: 29 classes of exposure, 1 shadow class, 2 families of 55 damaged -- quoting either number alone misdescribes the estate.
(5) WHAT STORED_IN NOW IS. A CLASS defect, not a cardinality one. Round 6's second cycle held: {1: 135}, no key at 2. CG-s-33 is an identity re-point, not a re-count.
